name: tvbox
description: Smart TV client + remote control + signaling server (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:remote && npm run build:tv
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @tvbox/backend && npm run typecheck -w @tvbox/remote-client && npm run typecheck -w @tvbox/tv-client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @tvbox/shared && npm run test -w @tvbox/backend && npm run test -w @tvbox/tv-client
